market_question: Russia x Ukraine ceasefire agreement by December 31, 2026?
reasoning: Russia and Ukraine remain far apart on core issues like territorial integrity and security guarantees. Despite occasional diplomatic overtures, a mutually agreed general ceasefire by end-2026 is unlikely given the entrenched positions and ongoing military stalemate that favors attrition. Many experts project a prolonged conflict beyond 2026.
evidence_points: No comprehensive peace talks have occurred since spring 2022.
Both sides demand preconditions that the other rejects: Ukraine insists on full Russian withdrawal, Russia demands recognition of annexed territories.
Historical precedents of frozen conflicts in post-Soviet space suggest years of negotiation before ceasefires.
